text:
Three of the five main uses of the hand are grip (grasping and holding), percussion (striking or tapping), and sensory (feeling texture, temperature and pressure). I'm taking this from the team note, which gave two candidate answers. I chose the first because it names functional categories of use, while "touch, feel, stroke" mostly overlaps with sensing. There is no single standard list of five, so this is a judgment call.

CONFIDENCE: 60
